name: kill-switch-phase1
description: Non-destructive kill switch paths on a throwaway HOME (issue #349). A terminal-tool `kollab --hub halt` is refused, a halt on a one-machine network says in one plain line that a second machine is needed. The Connect screen's Network State row and the h key are not covered here (see the D2 handoff). Nothing here halts anything: every path that would runs in tests/docker/kill_switch.

config.command: bash -c 'R=$(pwd); mkdir -p "$HOME/ws"; cd "$HOME/ws"; export KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 KOLLAB_NO_HUB=1 PYTHONPATH="$R" K="$R/.venv/bin/python $R/main.py"; exec bash --norc'

steps.pattern: Network controls run only from a person's terminal
Network controls run only from a person's terminal or Settings

steps.title: a person's terminal on a one-machine network

steps.pattern: This network has one machine that can confirm a resume
A halt needs a second one
